name: What information should I have ready before I ask for a quote?

mainEntity.name: What information should I have ready before I ask for a quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bring approximate vanity measurements, photos of the bathroom, and note whether you want one or two sinks, an undermount sink, or special cutouts. That information helps the installer give a more accurate estimate and avoid delays during fabrication or installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have vanity measurements, photos, sink style, and any special cutouts ready. That helps get a more accurate quote and fewer surprises later.
